name: Customer
description: Stores customer information and contact details for order processing and communication

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the customer

fields.name: email
fields.description: Customer email address for authentication and communication

fields.name: fullName
fields.description: Customer's full name

fields.name: phoneNumber
fields.description: Primary contact phone number

fields.name: shippingAddress
fields.description: Default shipping address for order delivery

fields.name: isActive
fields.description: Indicates if the customer account is active

fields.name: createdAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the customer account was created

constraints.email: Must be a valid email format
constraints.phoneNumber: Must be a valid phone number format

name: Product
description: Product catalog with pricing, descriptions, and inventory tracking

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique product identifier

fields.name: sku
fields.description: Stock keeping unit code for product identification

fields.name: name
fields.description: Product name or title

fields.name: description
fields.description: Detailed product description

fields.name: price
fields.description: Current selling price in base currency

fields.name: category
fields.description: Product category for classification and filtering

fields.name: stockQuantity
fields.description: Current available inventory count

fields.name: isActive
fields.description: Indicates if product is available for purchase

name: Inventory
description: Tracks real-time stock levels and inventory movements across warehouses with reorder points and reservations

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the inventory record

fields.name: productId
fields.description: Reference to the product being tracked

fields.name: warehouseLocation
fields.description: Physical warehouse or storage location identifier

fields.name: quantityAvailable
fields.description: Current available stock quantity (on-hand minus reserved)

fields.name: quantityReserved
fields.description: Quantity reserved for pending orders

fields.name: reorderPoint
fields.description: Minimum quantity threshold that triggers reorder alert

fields.name: lastUpdated
fields.description: Timestamp of the last inventory movement or adjustment

relationships.description: Each inventory record tracks stock for one product

constraints.uniqueProductWarehouse: Each product can have only one inventory record per warehouse location

name: Payment
description: Records payment transactions, methods, and status for orders with support for multiple attempts and refunds

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the payment transaction

fields.name: orderId
fields.description: Reference to the associated order

fields.name: amount
fields.description: Payment amount in the specified currency

fields.name: currency
fields.description: Three-letter ISO currency code (e.g., USD, EUR)

fields.name: paymentMethod
fields.description: Payment method used (e.g., credit_card, paypal, bank_transfer)

fields.name: transactionId
fields.description: External payment gateway transaction identifier

fields.name: status
fields.description: Payment status (pending, completed, failed, refunded, cancelled)

fields.name: paymentDate
fields.description: Timestamp when the payment was processed

constraints.status: Must be one of: pending, completed, failed, refunded, cancelled
constraints.currency: Must be valid ISO 4217 currency code

name: Shipment
description: Manages shipping details, tracking information, and delivery status for order fulfillment

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the shipment

fields.name: orderId
fields.description: Reference to the associated order

fields.name: trackingNumber
fields.description: Carrier-provided tracking number for shipment monitoring

fields.name: carrier
fields.description: Shipping carrier name (e.g., FedEx, UPS, USPS)

fields.name: status
fields.description: Current shipment status (pending, in_transit, delivered, failed)

fields.name: shippingAddress
fields.description: Complete delivery address for the shipment

fields.name: estimatedDeliveryDate
fields.description: Expected delivery date provided by carrier

fields.name: actualDeliveryDate
fields.description: Actual timestamp when shipment was delivered

constraints.validStatus: status must be one of: pending, in_transit, delivered, failed, cancelled

name: OrderStatus
description: Track order status changes and maintain status history timeline with complete audit trail

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the status record

fields.name: orderId
fields.description: Reference to the order being tracked

fields.name: status
fields.description: Status code (e.g., PENDING, CONFIRMED, PROCESSING, SHIPPED, DELIVERED, CANCELLED)

fields.name: timestamp
fields.description: Date and time when status change occurred

fields.name: changedBy
fields.description: User ID or system identifier that triggered the status change

fields.name: notes
fields.description: Additional notes or comments about the status change

fields.name: metadata
fields.description: JSON string containing additional context data for the status change

name: Order
description: Central order entity capturing order header information, items, pricing, and status throughout the order lifecycle

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique order identifier

fields.name: customerId
fields.description: Reference to the customer who placed the order

fields.name: orderDate
fields.description: Date and time when the order was placed

fields.name: status
fields.description: Current order status (pending, processing, shipped, delivered, cancelled)

fields.name: totalAmount
fields.description: Total order amount including taxes and discounts

fields.name: paymentId
fields.description: Reference to the payment transaction

fields.name: shipmentId
fields.description: Reference to the shipment details

constraints.totalAmount: Must be greater than or equal to 0
constraints.status: Must be one of: pending, processing, shipped, delivered, cancelled

name: OrderItem
description: Represents individual line items within an order, capturing product details, quantity, pricing, and discounts at time of purchase

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the order item

fields.name: orderId
fields.description: Reference to the parent order

fields.name: productId
fields.description: Reference to the product being ordered

fields.name: quantity
fields.description: Number of units ordered

fields.name: unitPrice
fields.description: Price per unit at time of purchase (snapshot for historical accuracy)

fields.name: discountAmount
fields.description: Total discount applied to this line item

fields.name: subtotal
fields.description: Line item total (quantity × unitPrice - discountAmount)

relationships.description: Each order item belongs to one order
Each order item references one product

constraints.unitPrice: Must be greater than or equal to 0
constraints.discountAmount: Must be greater than or equal to 0 and less than or equal to (quantity × unitPrice)

name: NotificationLog
description: Records all notifications sent to customers with delivery status and tracking information

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the notification log entry

fields.name: customerId
fields.description: Reference to the customer receiving the notification

fields.name: orderId
fields.description: Reference to the related order if applicable

fields.name: notificationType
fields.description: Type of notification (order_confirmation, shipment_update, payment_receipt, etc.)

fields.name: channel
fields.description: Delivery channel used (email, sms, push)

fields.name: deliveryStatus
fields.description: Current delivery status (pending, sent, delivered, failed, bounced)

fields.name: retryCount
fields.description: Number of delivery retry attempts made

fields.name: sentAt
fields.description: Timestamp when notification was sent or last attempted
